title: MaceWind
description: Mace Wind Backport brings the iconic Minecraft 1.21 Mace to Minecraft 1.16.5
body:
This mod is especially made for old version minecraft users. So that they can also practice mace in their single player world. 
Features-
1. Mace- Depends upon      converting fall damage into damage method.
2. Wind Charge- Depends upon giving knockback and setting up the fall damage to 0. 
3. Wind Burst Enchant- Depends upon giving the WC type knockback when player hits an entity.

{ Specialy made for practice of STUN SLAMS}

{ The moderator tries to make the mod on real mechanisms ,still successful a far}

{ They all are precisely researched and try to create them like 1.21 but still there are some type of ISSUES -
1. WC render problem .
2. WC fall damage if failed to clutch.
3. Lack of enchantments.

THE MOD WILL BE CORRECT AS SOON !!
